title: BEATS & BEETS-YOGA ON THE FARM
description: Come join us on the farm for FREE yoga and a Mini Farmers Market!
long_description:
Come join us on the farm for FREE yoga and a Mini Farmers Market!

About this Event

Flourish on the Farm!Come join us in person for a day filled with fun and fresh air and YOGA, hosted by TWEF, SWEETWATER FARMS HTX & REMEDI YOGA! Enjoy health, wellness, yoga, and fall harvest farmers market by Sweetwater Farms HTX!
October is Breast Cancer Awareness Month, so TWEF will have a special booth for health and wellness!
Please bring your yoga mat.😁
Gates will open at 9:00 AM, and yoga will begin at 9:30 AM.
